title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode3 Our Dream

meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I couldn't even get through one song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (How is it that those other people can perform out there the way they do?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho's been playing in front of complete strangers for some time now too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought that I'd gotten better after working with Kusanagi, but I'm still nowhere near Shiho's level...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I don't find a way to get better, at this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... It's a Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Such a cute but beautiful voice too...
I wonder who's singing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Wait, is that Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Isn't she in Shiho's class...?
She seems like the shy type but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's singing in a fairly crowded place too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She looks so confident and isn't hesitating at all.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Whoa, she's an awesome singer!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
I've seen her here and there lately.
I think she sings at events and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Really? Might be worth checking out!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All these people passing by are stopping to watch her sing. They all just completely captivated by her voice.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Everybody, thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
That was great!
Please come sing for us again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I will!
Bye, for now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Azusawa...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, um... Hoshino?
You're Shiho's friend, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sorry for bothering you like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Azusawa, I was blown away by the way you sang just now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Hehe. You're making me blush a little.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But you were so incredible, and looked so confident.
Do you always perform here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do. Well, I just started doing this, so I can't say "always" or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I usually sing as part of a group, but I'm also the one with the least experience...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone else either already has musical experience or has been doing this for years, so they're much better than I am.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm doing everything I can to catch up to them, which is why I'm singing in public or joining events by myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so amazing, Azusawa. I can't say enough about your drive and initiative...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a dream that I want to come true so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A dream?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. My friend, the one that's in my group, wants to put on a really big event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An event so big, it gets everyone watching... No, everybody involved happy and excited to be there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For now, I have to do what I can to catch up to everyone, but we definitely will someday...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's great...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Speaking of which, aren't you in a band with Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am, but we're also just starting out. Except Shiho. She's been playing bass since she was in elementary school, so she's very good now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's so focused when it comes to music and even wants to become a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A pro? That's so cool!
Do you want to be a pro too, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, there's no way I can ever be that good. There are just so many great musicians out there too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I want to help make Shiho's dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho's?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Even if it's not entirely possible for me to become one, I can at least help her get close to the level she wants to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's always teaching me so much, and I've been taking away from her own practice time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why I want to get better. Then I can help her play to her heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's wonderful! Your dream sounds so nice too, Hoshino...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure that I'd call it a dream, but I'd be happy if it came true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hoshino? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I haven't been feeling all that confident lately, and even tried to perform in public for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wasn't really able to play anything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was so scared that my voice would sound weird and ended up not being able to sing at all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't even make it through one song...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then you're just like me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In the beginning, I made a lot of mistakes, had equipment issues and felt like nothing was ever going to go well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But my teammates all came together and told me that they believe in me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So to make sure that I don't disappoint them, and to catch up to them, I'm practicing as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure Shiho feels the same way about you, Hoshino. That has to be why she's willing to teach you so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quit apologizing and let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do want to get better, but together... With all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right...
She did say that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If I'm going to actually help make her dream come true, I need to stop feeling sorry for myself and stand back up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Azusawa.
I'll keep doing what I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'm glad I could help.
